method.z: robust z vs trailing 1440 1m bars (t-1440..t-1), >= 360 valid (collector gaps); scale 1.4826*MAD, fallback 1.2533*meanAD when MAD = 0, floored at 1% of |median|; 3 s candles finalised > 60 s late dropped
method.features: imbalance = buy_notional - sell_notional; trades = n_buy + n_sell; volume = buy+sell notional; spread = TWA spread_bps; depth = depth_bid_25 + depth_ask_25; abs_ret = |1m log mid return|; liq = 1m liquidation notional
method.forward: log(mid_{t+h} / mid_t), mid at the close of minute t (entry after the anomaly minute is known)
method.sigma: sigma_h = sqrt(h * trailing-1440 mean of squared 1m mid returns)
method.warmup: first 1440 minutes of each symbol dropped (no trailing window); liquidation features need 1440 minutes after 2026-11-08 00:46 (collection start); minutes in collector outages are null (never zero) for flow and liquidations
method.blocks: calendar-hour blocks pooled across symbols (cross-sectional dependence kept inside a block), B = 2000
method.universe: Bybit linear perps in flow_3s (spot streams excluded); asset class TradFi = the TradFi stream groups in settings.flow.streams
method.verdict: supports = registered criterion met and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; contradicts = criterion fails and the 95% CI excludes the required effect; else inconclusive; < 30 events -> inconclusive
